scope: Only owned integration primaries with an explicit schema. Different-owner unversioned schemas are listed as out_of_scope, not silently dropped. Repetitions, continuations, forks, inherited requests and ticks are not independent preparations. This index validates exact artifacts and counts, not semantic mastery.
